quizzes.title: $x^2 - 7x + 12 = 0$ kvadrat tenglamaning ildizlari yig'indisi va ko'paytmasini toping.
quizzes.explanation:
Viyet teoremasiga ko'ra keltirilgan $x^2 + px + q = 0$ kvadrat tenglama uchun:
$$x_1 + x_2 = -p = -(-7) = 7$$
$$x_1 \cdot x_2 = q = 12$$
Ildizlarning o'zi esa $x_1 = 3$ va $x_2 = 4$ bo'ladi.

quizzes.title: Ifodaning qiymatini hisoblang: $\log_2(32) + \log_3\left(\frac{1}{9}\right) - \lg(100)$
$2^{x+2} + 2^x = 40$ ko'rsatkichli tenglamani yeching.
quizzes.explanation:
$2^x$ ni qavsdan tashqariga chiqaramiz:
$$2^x (2^2 + 1) = 40$$
$$2^x (4 + 1) = 40 \implies 2^x \cdot 5 = 40$$
$$2^x = \frac{40}{5} = 8$$
$$2^x = 2^3 \implies x = 3$$.

quizzes.title: Tengsizliklar sistemasini yeching: $\begin{cases} 3x - 5 > 4 \\ 2x + 3 \le 17 \end{cases}$
quizzes.explanation:
Har bir tengsizlikni alohida yechamiz:
1) $3x > 9 \implies x > 3$
2) $2x \le 14 \implies x \le 7$
Ikkala oraliqning kesishmasi: $x \in (3; 7]$.

quizzes.title: Cheksiz kamayuvchi geometrik progressiyada $b_1 = 12$ va maxraj $q = \frac{1}{3}$ bo'lsa, uning barcha hadlari yig'indisi $S$ ni toping.
quizzes.explanation:
Cheksiz kamayuvchi geometrik progressiya yig'indisi:
$$S = \frac{b_1}{1 - q} = \frac{12}{1 - \frac{1}{3}} = \frac{12}{\frac{2}{3}} = 12 \cdot \frac{3}{2} = 18$$.

quizzes.title: To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakning katetlari $a = 6$ sm va $b = 8$ sm ga teng. Gipotenuzaga tushirilgan balandlik $h_c$ ni toping.
quizzes.explanation:
Avval Pifagor teoremasi orqali gipotenuzani topamiz:
$$c = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2} = \sqrt{6^2 + 8^2} = \sqrt{36+64} = 10 \text{ sm}$$
Uchburchak yuzi formulasi orqali:
$$S = \frac{1}{2} a b = \frac{1}{2} c h_c$$
$$a \cdot b = c \cdot h_c \implies 6 \cdot 8 = 10 \cdot h_c$$
$$h_c = \frac{48}{10} = 4.8 \text{ sm}$$.

quizzes.title: Rombning diagonallari $d_1 = 12$ sm va $d_2 = 16$ sm bo'lsa, uning perimetri $P$ ni hisoblang.
quizzes.explanation:
Rombning diagonallari to'g'ri burchak ostida kesishadi va kesishish nuqtasida teng ikkiga bo'linadi:
Katetlar: $\frac{d_1}{2} = 6$ sm, $\frac{d_2}{2} = 8$ sm.
Romb tomoni $a = \sqrt{6^2 + 8^2} = 10$ sm.
Perimetr: $P = 4a = 4 \times 10 = 40$ sm.

quizzes.title: Muntazam uchburchakning tomoni $a = 4\sqrt{3}$ sm bo'lsa, unga tashqi chizilgan aylana radiusi $R$ ni toping.
quizzes.explanation:
Muntazam uchburchak uchun tashqi chizilgan aylana radiusi:
$$R = \frac{a}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{4\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{3}} = 4 \text{ sm}$$.

quizzes.title: Trapetsiyaning asoslari $a = 8$ sm va $b = 14$ sm, balandligi $h = 6$ sm bo'lsa, uning yuzi $S$ ni hisoblang.
quizzes.explanation:
Trapetsiya yuzi formulasi:
$$S = \frac{a + b}{2} \cdot h = \frac{8 + 14}{2} \cdot 6 = 11 \cdot 6 = 66 \text{ sm}^2$$.

quizzes.title: Ifodani soddalashtiring: $\frac{\sin(2\alpha)}{2\cos(\alpha)} + \cos^2(\alpha) + \sin^2(\alpha)$
quizzes.explanation:
Ikki karra burchak formulasi: $\sin(2\alpha) = 2\sin(\alpha)\cos(\alpha)$.
1) $\frac{2\sin(\alpha)\cos(\alpha)}{2\cos(\alpha)} = \sin(\alpha)$
2) Asosiy ayniyat: $\cos^2(\alpha) + \sin^2(\alpha) = 1$
Natija: $\sin(\alpha) + 1$.

quizzes.title: $\cos(x) = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$ tenglamaning $[0, \pi]$ kesmadagi ildizini toping.
quizzes.explanation: $\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right) = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$ (ya'ni $30^\circ$). $[0, \pi]$ oraliqda yagona ildiz $x = \frac{\pi}{6}$ dir.

quizzes.title: Agar $\tan(\alpha) = 2$ bo'lsa, $\frac{2\sin(\alpha) + 3\cos(\alpha)}{4\sin(\alpha) - 5\cos(\alpha)}$ kasrning qiymatini toping.
quizzes.explanation:
Kasrning surat va maxrajini $\cos(\alpha)$ ga bo'lamiz:
$$\frac{2\tan(\alpha) + 3}{4\tan(\alpha) - 5} = \frac{2(2) + 3}{4(2) - 5} = \frac{4 + 3}{8 - 5} = \frac{7}{3}$$.

quizzes.title: Ifodani hisoblang: $\sin(75^\circ) \cdot \cos(15^\circ) - \cos(75^\circ) \cdot \sin(15^\circ)$
quizzes.explanation:
Burchaklar ayirmasi sinusi formulasi:
$$\sin(\alpha - \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta - \cos\alpha\sin\beta$$
$$\sin(75^\circ - 15^\circ) = \sin(60^\circ) = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$$.

quizzes.title: Aniq integralni hisoblang: $\int_{0}^{2} (3x^2 - 2x + 1) \, dx$
quizzes.explanation:
Boshlang'ich funksiyani topamiz:
$$F(x) = \int (3x^2 - 2x + 1) dx = x^3 - x^2 + x$$
Nyuton-Leybnis formulasi bo'yicha:
$$F(2) - F(0) = (2^3 - 2^2 + 2) - 0 = (8 - 4 + 2) = 6$$.

quizzes.title: $f(x) = x^3 - 3x^2 + 5$ funksiyaning $x = 2$ nuqtadagi hosilasi $f'(2)$ ni hisoblang.
Limitni hisoblang: $\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin(7x)}{x}$
quizzes.explanation:
Birinchi ajoyib limit formulasiga ko'ra $\lim_{t \to 0} \frac{\sin(t)}{t} = 1$.
$$\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin(7x)}{x} = \lim_{x \to 0} \left( \frac{\sin(7x)}{7x} \cdot 7 \right) = 1 \cdot 7 = 7$$.

quizzes.title: $y = x^2 - 4x + 3$ parabolaning uchi (ekstremum nuqtasi) koordinatalarini toping.
quizzes.explanation:
Hosila orqali: $y' = 2x - 4 = 0 \implies x_0 = 2$.
$y_0 = 2^2 - 4(2) + 3 = 4 - 8 + 3 = -1$.
Parabola uchi koordinatalari: $(2; -1)$.

quizzes.title: Aritmetik progressiyada $a_1 = 3$ va ayirma $d = 4$ bo'lsa, dastlabki $10$ ta hadi yig'indisi $S_{10}$ ni toping.
quizzes.explanation:
Aritmetik progressiya dastlabki $n$ ta hadi yig'indisi formulasi:
$$S_n = \frac{2a_1 + (n - 1)d}{2} \cdot n$$
$$S_{10} = \frac{2(3) + (10 - 1) \cdot 4}{2} \cdot 10 = \frac{6 + 36}{2} \cdot 10 = \frac{42}{2} \cdot 10 = 21 \cdot 10 = 210$$.

quizzes.title: Agar $x + \frac{1}{x} = 5$ bo'lsa, $x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}$ ning qiymatini toping.
quizzes.explanation:
Tenglikning ikkala tomonini kvadratga ko'taramiz:
$$\left(x + \frac{1}{x}\right)^2 = 5^2$$
$$x^2 + 2 \cdot x \cdot \frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{x^2} = 25$$
$$x^2 + 2 + \frac{1}{x^2} = 25 \implies x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2} = 25 - 2 = 23$$.

quizzes.title: Qavariq ko'pburchakning ichki burchaklari yig'indisi $1260^\circ$ ga teng bo'lsa, uning tomonlari soni $n$ ni toping.
quizzes.explanation:
Qavariq $n$-burchak ichki burchaklari yig'indisi formulasi: $180^\circ(n - 2)$.
$$180^\circ(n - 2) = 1260^\circ$$
$$n - 2 = \frac{1260}{180} = 7 \implies n = 7 + 2 = 9$$.
